expected: Actual intended transcript resumes without re-executing completed tools to reconstruct history.
limitations: A ~7K-token session; replay cost grows with the transcript (G17 measured 100K-token prefills).
observed: A print-mode session ran append.py once and read a nonce; a new OMP process continued it (client restart) and recalled the nonce in 1.2 s with the live prefix cache intact; then the whole server was stopped and started (ready in 14.6 s) and a new OMP process continued again and recalled the nonce after a cold re-prefill of 7320 tokens (1853 ms; turn 3.0 s). The transcript holds exactly 1 append.py call and log.txt 1 line: completed tools were not re-executed.
